# proxychains-ng 4.17 Ubuntu arm64 runtime asset


The unmodified Linux routing library is extracted from Ubuntu noble arm64 libproxychains4 4.17-1. It runs inside the Ubuntu child rootfs. It is not an Android executable or a new Host primitive.


The upstream source archive and Ubuntu Debian packaging archive are included beside this file. The original copyright and full GPL-2 license are included in the child assets. See [upstream](https://github.com/rofl0r/proxychains-ng/tree/v4.17) and [Ubuntu package](https://packages.ubuntu.com/noble/libproxychains4).


Package source URL: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/ubuntu-ports/pool/universe/p/proxychains-ng/libproxychains4_4.17-1_arm64.deb


Package SHA-256: f5f57a48c1ac9b8638d6afa50829b1d6b84fd66dc283dc0a600fc3d4302de4cc


Library SHA-256: cf0904bf69e8fb4520828e1f5713724ddbaab0a7787fca55e7537329e1cd6d06


Upstream source SHA-256: 1a2dc68fcbcb2546a07a915343c1ffc75845f5d9cc3ea5eb3bf0b62a66c0196f


Debian packaging SHA-256: 851644eca979512c049977477256f20317a47f6cf35758d3e29968b04bf43e99


The library hooks dynamically linked TCP clients and remote DNS. Static executables, UDP/ICMP and clients bypassing libc hooks are outside the verified routing scope. No upstream source changes are applied.
